name: skeleton
title: Skeleton / Shimmer Text
description: 骨架屏与微光文字：共享一道柔和扫光。
docs:
- `width / height / radius` (number | string，默认 -)：尺寸与圆角
- `circle` (boolean，默认 false)：圆形（头像）

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import type { SkeletonProps } from "./types";

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SkeletonProps>(), {});

/** 数字与纯数字字符串都转 px；其余（%, rem…）原样 */
const len = (v: number | string | undefined) => {
  if (v === undefined) return undefined;
  if (typeof v === "number") return `${v}px`;
  return /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(v) ? `${v}px` : v;
};

const style = computed(() => {
  const w = len(props.width ?? "100%");
  const h = len(props.height ?? "12px");
  return {
    width: props.circle ? h : w,
    height: h,
    borderRadius: props.circle ? "50%" : len(props.radius ?? "6px"),
  };
});
</script>

<template>
  <span class="va-skel" :style="style" aria-hidden="true" />
</template>

<style>
/* VaSkeleton — 共享一道扫光的骨架块（底色/高光用中性半透明，亮暗主题都能与卡片区分） */
.va-skel {
  display: inline-block;
  vertical-align: middle;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      100deg,
      var(--va-skel-bg, rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.28)) 40%,
      var(--va-skel-hl, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55)) 50%,
      var(--va-skel-bg, rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.28)) 60%
    )
    var(--va-skel-bg, rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.28));
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  background-position: 200% 0;
  animation: va-skel-shimmer 1.6s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes va-skel-shimmer {
  from { background-position: 200% 0; }
  to { background-position: -200% 0; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .va-skel { animation: none; }
}
</style>
